---

### 🔄 Change Policy for BK-B70889

Since your booking is **Business class** on a **domestic** route (JFK → LHR is listed as domestic in the system), the following rules apply:

| Rule | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Free Change Window** | Free changes within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking |
| **Business Class** | ✅ **Free changes** — no change fee (fare difference still applies) |
| **Fare Difference** | If the new flight costs more, you pay the difference; if less, the difference is credited |

### Special Circumstance Waivers (if applicable)

Even though Business class already gets free changes, these apply generally:
